_help: Puzzle-room objects. mem/puzzle.mem is GENERATED from this file + the PNGs.  Rebuild: python scripts/build_puzzle_mem.py

16 frames of 32x32: 0 bulb off, 1 bulb on, 2 lever up, 3 lever down, 4 box, 5 gate closed, 6 gate open, 7-9 item of floor 1-3, 10-13 = maze ball rotation (AXIALE orb, W7), 14 = the boss-3 key item, 15 unused.
Each file (16x16) is scaled by exactly 'scale' (2, nearest neighbour). 'tint' recolours by luminance (see tints).
A frame can also come from a sprite_tool .mem file: {"mem": "my_asset/props/torch.mem", "frame": 0} (header W= H= FRAMES= KEY=). Bulbs: frame 0 = lit torch, frame 7 = smouldering ember.

Levers = my_asset/new_switch.png (3x3 cells of 32x32, 7 frames read left-to-right, top-to-bottom): frame 1 = cell [0,0] fully left = lever up, frame 4 = cell [1,0] fully right = lever down; frames 2,3,5,6 are in-between animation (unused), frame 7 = cell [2,0] fully left.
A frame may use {"file": sheet.png, "cell": [row, col], "scale": 1} (32x32 cells, per-frame scale).
cut = list of exact [r,g,b] background colours that become see-through (so the floor colour shows through).
Missing / skipped / empty file -> old art from mem/puzzle_v1.mem with a warning. Keys starting with _ are comments.
